title: Introducing the Codex app
summary: Introducing the Codex app for macOS—a command center for AI coding and software development with multiple agents, parallel workflows, and long-running tasks.
body: Introducing the Codex app for macOS—a command center for AI coding and software development with multiple agents, parallel workflows, and long-running tasks.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了专为macOS设计的Codex应用程序。该应用作为一个集中式的AI编程与软件开发控制中心，支持多智能体协同、并行工作流处理以及长时间运行的复杂编程任务，显著提升开发者的编码效率。原始信息显示：Introducing the Codex app for macOS—a command center for AI coding and software development with multiple agents, parallel workflows, and long-running tasks.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing the Codex app”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出面向macOS的Codex应用，提供支持多智能体与并行工作流的AI编程控制中心。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
